The web app lets signed-in users explore Projects and Locations, while search and coordinate inspection work independently of iCloud sign-in. This branch contains the browser guide and the implementation and deployment notes.

The browser app is a static JavaScript site. It reuses shared CloudKit authentication, reads Project and Location data, and owns one MapKit JS map instance. Focused modules handle the Project selector, search, place detail, and coordinates.
